selection_rule: Curate 18 distinct root parents from the complete checked-in source-map set before any new run, balancing six additive, six modified, and six scale edits. Require an executable parent precondition and deterministic target scorer. Historical children establish feasibility and naming only; their scores are not selection inputs.
sampling_claim: This is a curated challenge set, not a random or unbiased sample. Success rate is conditional on this fixed challenge set and must not be generalized as an unbiased population estimate.

runtime.pricing_note: Freeze actual token accounting and estimated CNY. USD is unavailable and no exchange rate is inferred.

common_pv_a_mapping.scale: task.scorer.scale for scale edits; N/A otherwise
common_pv_a_mapping.geometry_locality: changed semantic geometry names are restricted to target/dependent-consumer patterns
common_pv_a_mapping.structural_locality: joint/link graph delta is restricted to task.scorer.allowed_structural_delta
common_pv_a_mapping.hierarchy: compile --target full --validate plus deterministic joint-parent/name checks
common_pv_a_mapping.qc: parent and fresh child compile --target full --validate; no manual blind-review value is imputed
common_pv_a_mapping.cost: actual uncached/cached input and output tokens plus frozen CNY estimate

scorer_contract.pass_conjunction: compile && target_fulfilled && anchor_preserved && non_target_preserved && structural_locality && geometry_locality && scale_if_applicable
scorer_contract.visual_signature: primitive parameters, mesh content SHA-256, material/color/texture, local bounds/extents, and local origin
scorer_contract.joint_signature: type, parent, child, axis, lower limit, and upper limit; origin is excluded to allow preregistered interface refits
scorer_contract.historical_gold_gate: All 18 historical direct-child gold records must compile and pass this identical scorer before any fresh API run.
